$comment: Brasaland telemetry contract. See telemetry-plan.md for the reasoning behind every decision here. Envelope fields are shared by every event; 'properties' is allow-listed per event_type — no additional properties are ever permitted.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601, UTC, set at moment of capture

sessionId.description: Generated once per frontend app load, independent of auth state

schemaVersion.description: Starts at 1 per event_type; bump only on a breaking change to that event's properties

requestId.description: Null for events with no single corresponding backend call

properties.description: See events[].properties for the allowlist per event_type

events.hypothesis: We need to know how much and what is being purchased, by location and supplier
events.decision: Consolidate purchasing across locations to negotiate better prices (Lucía)

country.description: Null until location registry is resolved — see plan §2

unit_cost.description: Added for the business performance pipeline's Purchase Cost per Location KPI. Already computed server-side (routes/inventory.py create_entry) — previously not captured on this event. See PIPELINE_DESIGN.md 'Schema prerequisite #1'.

events.hypothesis: We need to know which ingredients are consumed most, and at what rate, by location
events.decision: Adjust the automatic supplier order suggestion (Felipe)

events.status: partial — requires new optional waste_reason field on IngredientExitCreate (default None)
events.hypothesis: We need to know how much product is lost, why, and at which location
events.decision: Prioritise waste audits at the worst-performing locations (Felipe)

unit_cost.description: Added for the business performance pipeline's Waste Cost per Location KPI. Backend-computed from the ingredient's most recent purchase price (routes/inventory.py create_exit) — waste has no purchase price of its own. See PIPELINE_DESIGN.md 'Schema prerequisite #1'.

events.status: blocked — requires new optional minimum_stock field on Ingredient (default None)
events.source: not yet implementable — no minimum_stock concept exists on Ingredient
events.hypothesis: We need to know how often a location runs short of a key ingredient
events.decision: Adjust the minimum threshold or the replenishment frequency for that product

events.status: blocked — no endpoint accepts a stock-modifying field to reject today
events.hypothesis: We need to know if staff are attempting to bypass traceability controls
events.decision: Reinforce training or permissions at the locations where this happens most (Jake)

events.status: blocked — requires new optional unit_cost field on IngredientEntryCreate plus a historical average source
events.source: not yet implementable — no cost data is captured anywhere today
events.hypothesis: We need to know when a key ingredient rises in price abnormally
events.decision: Alert Lucía and Mariana to renegotiate or find an alternate supplier

events.hypothesis: We need to know how often new SKUs are added
events.decision: Tells us whether catalogue growth is deliberate or ad hoc, and whether a formal approval step is worth adding

country.description: Ingredient.country — the product's own sourcing market, NOT a location's country. Do not reuse for currency derivation.

events.hypothesis: We need to know login volume/patterns over time
events.decision: Feeds the auth_failure_rate metric in the Report project

events.hypothesis: We need to know how often auth fails and why
events.decision: Spot brute-force attempts or login-UX friction; feeds auth_failure_rate

failure_reason.description: Never the email or password value entered

events.hypothesis: We need to know how often users need password recovery
events.decision: A spike signals a login/memorability UX problem

events.hypothesis: We need to know how often and where uncaught errors happen
events.decision: Prioritise bug triage by frequency and location

error_message.description: Truncated and sanitised — never a raw stack trace that could contain user input

events.source: captured client-side after any backend call completes
events.hypothesis: We need to know which endpoints are slow, and whether that changes by time or location
We need to know which sections operators actually use
events.decision: Invest UX effort where it matters; deprioritise unused features
